setup.notInstaller: This file does not contain KyberNow Link ({error}). Download the full installer again.
setup.webview2Ask:
Setup and the KyberNow Link app are displayed with WebView2, Microsoft's display engine (the one in Edge). It is missing on this PC.

Download and install it now? (about 2 MB, then Microsoft's installer)
setup.webview2Failed:
WebView2 could not be installed: {error}

Microsoft's page will open: install “Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime”, then run this installer again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall KyberNow Link
uninstall.confirm:
KyberNow Link will be removed from this PC: the app, its shortcuts and its kybernow:// link.

Your computers themselves do not change.

Continue?
uninstall.erase:
Also erase your list of computers, their settings and their passwords?

No: they will still be there if you reinstall KyberNow Link.

windows.title: Windows
windows.old: Build {build}: KyberNow Link is designed for Windows 10 22H2 (19045) or later. Install the Windows updates.

arch.title: Processor
arch.arm64: The ARM64 version of KyberNow Link will be installed: it runs without emulation, with the chip's video decoding.
arch.x64: The x64 version of KyberNow Link will be installed.

gpu.title: Graphics card
gpu.ok: {name}{more}: it decodes the picture, for lower latency and longer battery life.
gpu.basic: Windows basic driver: the picture will be decoded by the processor. Install the graphics card driver for better performance.

display.title: Display
display.unknown: Unknown size: KyberNow Link will fit the window.
display.ok: {width} × {height} · {hz} Hz: your computer can take exactly this size during the session.

network.title: Local network
network.ok: {ip}: a computer on this network shows up in KyberNow Link on its own.
network.none: No network for now: join one before connecting to a computer.

webview.title: Display engine
webview.ok: Version {version}, by Microsoft: it draws the KyberNow Link interface.
webview.missing: Missing: it will be downloaded and installed (about 2 MB).

existing.label: Installed version
existing.title: KyberNow Link {version} is installed
existing.detail: It will be updated. Your computers, their passwords and your settings stay.

running.title: KyberNow Link is open
running.detail: It will be closed during installation: a session in progress will stop.

errors.appWontClose: KyberNow Link is still open and will not close. Close it, then try again.
errors.placeFiles: could not put the files in {dir}
errors.placeFilesOld: could not put the files in place, and the previous version was left in {dir}
errors.noApp: the app cannot be found in the installer (damaged file?)
errors.noArch: this installer does not contain the {arch} version of KyberNow Link
errors.webview2Start: the WebView2 installer did not start: {error}
